address: 49 Bat Dan Street, Hoan Kiem Ward, Hanoi, 10000, Vietnam
bio: One of Hanoi's most iconic eateries, Phở Gia Truyền exemplifies the Northern approach to phở with three options: rare flank, medium rare round or well-done brisket. Each delicious bowl is made to order at the counter, and diners can add crispy quẩy or a golden egg yolk for richness.
